source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Οσία Αναστασώ η εν τοις Λευκαδίου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and says of her only that she fell asleep in holiness and in peace. **Nothing in the corpus reads as her**: the name appears in no folder, and it is not the common Anastasia — the page's form is Αναστασώ. **The display name keeps the place**, «η εν τοις Λευκαδίου», she of the Leukadion quarter, which is all that distinguishes her; the page explains it, and the explanation is what the rest of its body is: «Το Λευκάδιον ή Λαυκάτιον έκειτο κατά την βιθυνική παραλία, όχι μακριά από την περιοχή του Ακρίτα, πολύ πιθανώς κοντά στη Δακιβύζη» — it lay on the Bithynian shore, not far from the district of Akritas, very probably near Dakibyze. **No `locations` object** although that sentence names three places, because the page itself puts the last of them at «πολύ πιθανώς», very probably. **No year of any kind, so no `dates` object.** No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
